nam_pho: Nam Phố Đường, dawn talisman scribes of a river-shore school: fine undyed hemp robes in mulberry grey, clean and well pressed, with faint ink stains at the cuffs and forearms; scribes of the dusk line add a violet hem; the hall-mistress pins her hair with a writing brush; a brush or ink stick always close.
cuu_cao: Cửu Cao Phái, crane riders and grooms of the marsh: riders wear well-cut grey felt tunics under cloaks edged with soft white crane down; grooms wear neat capes of woven pale reed over plain marsh-green cloth, hems tied up for wading; riders' leather wrist guards; a pale grey-and-white feather somewhere on every person.
yen_quang: Yên Quang Các, alchemist-pickers of the evening glow: smoke-grey robes of good cloth with the sleeves tied back by cords, an herb pouch at the hip, a straw cape for the field; knees patched in neat brown leather; inner disciples carry a sprig of their first herb tucked at the collar; the head and elders add a pale violet inner collar.
